title: Federal partial filling of Schedule III through V prescriptions
rule_summary: A Schedule III through V prescription may be partially filled if each partial fill is recorded like a refill, the total does not exceed the prescribed quantity, and dispensing occurs within six months after issue.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply schedule iii-v requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Federal partial filling of Schedule III through V prescriptions

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing schedule iii-v with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
